Hey guys! Kya plan hai Manali trip ka?
Mujhe toh bohot excitement ho rahi hai!
Haan yaar! Kab ja rahe hain?
Main toh bas date confirm karna chahta hoon.
Mujhe toh bas yeh decide karna hai ki hotel kaunsa book karna hai.
Kya hum bus se jaaye? Train se jana better hoga?
Bus thoda uncomfortable hota hai, train mein zyada space hota hai.
Train se jaana sahi rahega. Kya koi last-minute deals hai?
Booking karne se pehle humare paas dates toh honi chahiye.
Awesome! Toh ab hum dates decide karte hain.
Meri taraf se toh next weekend theek hai.
Mujhe bhi wahi weekend suit karega.
Chalo, ab hotel ka bhi plan bana lete hain.
Maine suna hai ki Mall Road ke paas achhe hotels hain.
Haan, aur wahan se sightseeing bhi aasaan hoga.
Toh kya sab agree hain Mall Road ke paas hotel book karne par?
Mujhe bhi wahi sahi lag raha hai.
Perfect! Toh main booking kar deta hoon.
Kya hum kuch adventure activities bhi plan kar sakte hain?
Definitely! Par pehle booking toh ho jaye.

Hey guys, kya koi flat dekhne gaye hai? Rent deposit ka kya scene hai?
Mujhe suna hai ki kuch jagah pe 2 months ka rent as deposit lete hain.
Haan, par mujhe lagta hai ki wo thoda zyada hai. Kya koi limit hai?
Haan bhai, mujhe bhi pata hai ki kuch jagah pe 1 month ka hi lete hain.
Mujhe bhi flat dhoondhna hai. Deposit limit ka kya hai?
Mujhe bhi dekhna hai, par mujhe pata nahi flat ke liye kya expect karna hai.
Waisa, mujhe toh 3 months ka deposit bhi zyada lagta hai.
Haan, 3 months toh bahut ho gaya. 1 month se zyada nahi hona chahiye.
Kya aaj kal landlords itna lete hai? Yeh toh unfair hai.
Ek baar flat dekhlo, phir negotiate karna.
Negotiation ka kya karna hai, max 5k per person bro usse zyada nahi.
max 5k per person bro usse zyada nahi
Bilkul! Agar 5k se zyada hua toh alag flat dekhna padega.
Haan, mujhe bhi 5k hi sahi lagta hai. Waise koi bhi flat dikh raha hai?
Mujhe ek flat mila hai, par deposit 10k hai. Bahut zyada hai!
10k toh bahut zyada hai, wo flat mat lo.
Toh kya hum ek saath kisi flat ka agreement kar sakte hain?
Haan, agar saath mil kar rahenge toh deposit ka pressure kam hoga.
Bilkul, par mujhe bhi flat dekhna hai jo affordable ho.
Chalo, sab milke dekhte hain, phir discuss karte hain.
Theek hai, toh chalo weekend pe flat dekhne chalte hain!

Guys, abhi toh Diya ka birthday hai na? Gift kya lena hai?
Haan, mujhe bhi yeh sochna hai. Diya ko kya pasand hai?
Mujhe lagta hai ek achha watch gift karna chahiye.
Watch toh acha hai, par Diya ko gadgets bhi pasand hain. Kya kisi game ka option hai?
Gamepad mangwa lete hain, watch rehne do.
Haan, gamepad toh mast option hai! Kya Diya ko gaming pasand hai?
Oh wow, mujhe gaming bahut pasand hai!
Perfect! Toh gamepad lete hain. Kaunsa brand le?
gamepad mangwa lete hain, watch rehne do.
Logitech ka gamepad acha hai, koi aur suggestion?
Sony ka dual shock bhi sahi hai, but thoda costly hai.
Chalo, budget decide kar lete hain pehle.
Mere hisaab se 3k tak ka budget sahi hai.
Haan, mujhe bhi lagta hai 3k mein acchi quality mil jayegi.
Mujhe jo bhi milega, main toh khush rahungi!
Okay, toh 3k ka gamepad dekhte hain.
Main online check karta hoon, kuch options bhejta hoon.
Perfect! Fir decide kar lenge kis se order karna hai.
Kya delivery time check karna hai? Birthday ke liye time hai?
Haan, delivery time confirm karna important hai.
